title: Ever Works integration contract v1 — shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every resource DTO, the event envelope and the error envelope. Source of truth: 03-events-sync-engine-and-contract.md Part B (homelab plan) as mirrored in ../../spec.md.

DateTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with milliseconds, e.g. 2026-10-15T18:00:00.000Z.

Seq.description: Decimal string form of the global, monotonic domain_events.seq. Opaque to consumers except for ordering events of ONE aggregate: compare as big integers, never as strings.

Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass it back unchanged.

Version.description: Aggregate version. Starts at 1 and is incremented on every change to the aggregate, including edge/child changes. Echoed as ETag: "<version>" and accepted as If-Match: "<version>".

Visibility.description: Scope of a record served to an integration (D11). `private` records are never served; see VisibilityChanged for the one place `private` appears.

Actor.description: Who caused a change or created a record.

id.description: users.id, agents.id, api_keys.id (integration) or a stable system id (e.g. `pr-status-cron`, `system`). Always set.

label.description: Display label at the time of the change (username, agent name, key name).

Owner.description: The owning principal of a record (today's per-user ownership is kept, D6).

ExternalLink.description: One external_record_links row, filtered to the caller's source.

installationId.description: The integration installation the link belongs to (for Gauzy: the Gauzy connection id).

ExternalRef.description: Sent on creates (B.6): the row and its external_record_links row are created atomically; a repeat with the same externalRef answers 200 with the existing entity.

installationId.description: The integration installation (for Gauzy: the connection id), as in external_record_links. Optional; when omitted it is taken from X-Sync-Origin (`gauzy:<connectionId>` → `<connectionId>`), else null.

TeamIds.description: teamId plus the team_resources rows, as one set. Writable on POST/PATCH; the first id is stored as teamId where the entity has that column. Non-empty means visibility `team` unless visibilityExplicit (D11).

ResourceBase.description: Fields every versioned integration DTO carries (B.6).

visibilityExplicit.description: true once a human picked the visibility by hand; automatic team<->organization changes stop (D11).

Page.description: List response shape (B.1). Lists are ordered by (updatedAt, id).
